items.title: Sakana AI introduces Multi-Agent Self-Supervision (MASS)
items.summary_en: Sakana AI describes a method in which a model learns from its own team of agents, with a paper on arXiv and code on GitHub. According to the search-result summary of the page, a 27B open-weights model reached 1.2 to 1.6 times the base model's output quality per token across four research benchmarks.
items.notes: Page not fetched (sakana.ai DNS failure); from web-search snippet. Verify. Date and figures unverified.

items.title: Sakana AI announces a Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) Lab
items.summary_en: Sakana AI's post introduces a research group focused on recursive self-improvement. According to the search-result summary, Jürgen Schmidhuber joined as Chief Scientific Advisor in September 2026.
items.notes: Post's own date not visible; 2026-09-24 is an estimate from a third-party aggregator (briefia.fr). Likely before the window start; context for MASS only. Drop if outside window.
